newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil using CVRD funds to pay off debt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil using CVRD funds to pay off debt.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury will use 1.55 billion reais in proceeds from the selloff of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) to retire short-term debt, the Treasury said in a statement.

"For this reason, the Treasury will refinance only 2.25 billion reais in an auction tomorrow, May 14, even though the expiry of Treasury securities in the second half of May amounts to 3.8 billion reais," it said.
National Treasury head Eduardo Guimaraes said the Treasury would save 334 million reais in interest payments per year because of the debt retirement.

The other half of the 3.3 billion reais raised in the sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting stock earlier this month will go into a special Economic Reconstruction Fund (FRE) and be used to finance infrastructure projects.
